integrity: The proof supplies explicit unobstructed geodesics for total visibility and a sharp uniqueness argument from the unique same-side geodesics through the spine, including a separate complete boundary argument at r=2. The standalone checker independently enumerates shortest paths and every vertex subset in the tested range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs with at least two pages.
Longer-cycle books and arbitrary generalized theta graphs are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 7 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed equivalent treatment.
title: Four mutual-visibility parameters of square-page book graphs
